title: MungTangE Benchmark v1
description: Ten deterministic frontend tasks; two paired prompts, held-out browser assertions and identical tool/model settings.
output_contract: A self-contained index.html plus optional relative CSS/JS/assets in the provided clean workspace. No CDN, network, external APIs, server or authentication. Data-testid hooks are only test selectors; both groups get identical specifications.

tasks.title: Accessible contact form
tasks.goal: Build a working contact form with name, email, message and submit, inline validation, and a local-only success confirmation.
contract: All fields have visible labels; email type=email; do not send network requests.
Use data-testid=name,email,message,submit,status; status has data-state=error/success.
Invalid email must show status error, valid values must show success after submit.

tasks.title: Todo task list
tasks.goal: Build a working list where users can add, complete and delete tasks.
contract: Use data-testid=todo-input,add-todo,todo-item; each todo-item contains data-testid=toggle-todo and delete-todo.
Completed item has data-state=done and can be removed.
Never use noninteractive spans for action buttons.

tasks.title: FAQ disclosure accordion
tasks.goal: Build a responsive FAQ with three accessible expandable question panels.
contract: Provide 3 elements data-testid=faq-toggle and corresponding data-testid=faq-panel.
Buttons have aria-expanded reflecting state; panels are hidden when collapsed.
Opening and closing by click and keyboard must work.

tasks.title: Responsive mobile navigation
tasks.goal: Build a responsive site header with mobile toggle, visible nav links, escape to dismiss and accessible keyboard focus.
contract: At 375px, use data-testid=menu-toggle,nav-menu,nav-link.
Menu toggle has correct aria-expanded; opening reveals links, Escape closes it.
At desktop width navigation should remain usable; no horizontal overflow.

tasks.title: Catalog category filter
tasks.goal: Build a product collection with at least six cards across books and clothing categories, category filter and text search.
contract: Use data-testid=category-filter (select with all/books/clothes), search-input, product-card.
Product cards include data-category=books or clothes; filter and search update visible cards.
Reset to all and empty search shows all cards.

tasks.title: Signup validation UX
tasks.goal: Build a local-only signup form with email, password, confirm password and clear error/success states.
contract: Use data-testid=signup-email,password,confirm-password,signup-submit,signup-status.
Mismatched confirmation sets signup-status data-state=error.
Matching password and valid email set signup-status data-state=success; do not store credentials.

tasks.title: Sortable data table
tasks.goal: Build a table containing at least five named rows with numeric amounts, sortable ascending/descending and searchable.
contract: Use data-testid=sort-amount,table-row,table-search,empty-state.
Each table-row has data-amount numeric attribute; click sort-amount toggles ascending/descending.
A search with zero matches shows empty-state; actual <table> markup is preferred.

tasks.title: Accessible dialog
tasks.goal: Build a modal dialog opened by button, closed by close button or Escape, with focus return.
contract: Use data-testid=open-dialog,close-dialog; dialog has role=dialog or native <dialog>.
Escape closes it; after close focus returns to open-dialog.
While open the dialog is visible and has an accessible name.

tasks.title: Live price calculator
tasks.goal: Build a price calculator with quantity, unit price, and computed currency total.
contract: Use data-testid=quantity,unit-price,total.
Values update the total automatically, including quantity change.
Total numeric value must equal quantity * unit price; label controls accessibly.

tasks.title: Keyboard accessible tabs
tasks.goal: Build three tabs and panels for Overview, Details, Settings with keyboard navigation.
contract: Use role=tablist, three role=tab; data-testid=tab-overview,tab-details,tab-settings.
Each tab uses aria-selected and controls one role=tabpanel; only selected panel visible.
Click and ArrowRight/ArrowLeft activation or focus behavior should follow accessible tab conventions.
